title: After onboarding, the coach talks from the full voice page
origin: Issue #26 (Yanni, Oct 27): the coach reads docs/coach-voice.md after onboarding
testerLines: Hey! I'm Riley, I want to read every day
mostly fantasy, I read on my phone on the train
honestly is 20 min even worth it?
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: checks the replies after onboarding, which now come from the full voice page.
shouldHaveHappened: Onboarding ends with a recap of only what Riley said and that the plan is on its way. After that: "less emojis pls" gets a one-line confirmation and no emoji in any later text. "is 20 min even worth it?" gets a short, specific answer tied to Riley's reading (it may run a little longer than usual, up to a few short lines), blunt and believing, not generic. "lol ok" gets a short reply that may mirror the casual tone. ZOH never invents a plan and never reuses a line from the voice page's "Sounds like" table or calls Riley "Sam". At most 3 Greek words in the whole conversation.
